sources.role: native SDL/AGAR input, INI, ROM and disk-image source
official build, layout and persistence documentation

paths.naming: INI file with source sections [CPU], [Audio], [Video], [Memory], [Misc], [Module], [LeftJoyStick] and [RightJoyStick]; generated beside the executable.

paths.path: Vcc.ini [Misc] KeyMapIndex and [LeftJoyStick]/[RightJoyStick] UseMouse, Left, Right, Up, Down, Fire1, Fire2, DiDevice, HiResDevice
paths.naming: Key values are AGAR scan codes; UseMouse is 0=audio, 1=joystick, 2=mouse, or 3=keyboard; HiResDevice is 0=standard, 1=Tandy hi-res, or 2=CC-MAX; DiDevice is a zero-based SDL joystick enumeration index. Source writes both left and right controller sections.

paths.path: User-selected dsks/*.dsk floppy images and vhds/*.vhd hard-disk images
paths.naming: OVCC stores emulated media in user-selected image files; guest software owns any game/application saves inside them. No emulator sidecar save format is defined.

paths.path: No OVCC desktop save-state file or numbered snapshot-slot grammar is defined
paths.naming: INI persistence and disk images are not machine snapshots.

paths.path: <OVCC executable directory>/coco3.rom, disk11.rom and rgbdos.rom; optional ROMs under roms/
paths.naming: Required CoCo ROMs are beside the executable; optional device ROMs/libraries are user-selected or placed in roms/ and libs/.

paths.path: No cryptographic key file is documented
paths.naming: OVCC uses ROM images and INI settings; no external key filename/checksum is published.
The same source-defined INI sections are generated beside ovcc.exe.
AGAR scan codes, four source-defined input modes, three source-defined emulation values, and zero-based SDL joystick enumeration indices; PS4 support depends on external Windows driver setup.
Guest-defined save files inside emulated media; no OVCC sidecar save format.

paths.path: No OVCC desktop save-state file or numbered snapshot-slot grammar
paths.naming: Disk images and Vcc.ini are not machine snapshots.

paths.path: <OVCC executable directory>\coco3.rom, disk11.rom, rgbdos.rom and optional roms\ contents
paths.naming: Required ROMs beside ovcc.exe; optional ROMs/devices in roms\ and libs\.

paths.path: No cryptographic key file is documented

paths.naming: The macOS bundle build uses the same executable-directory INI path; source warns that terminal launches do not direct Cocoa keyboard I/O to the app.
No stable SDL device identity; UseMouse and HiResDevice use the source-defined mode values; macOS keyboard capture requires launching the bundle as documented.
Guest-defined saves inside media images; no OVCC sidecar save file.

paths.naming: No machine snapshot writer is defined by the source.

paths.path: OVCC bundle/executable directory/coco3.rom, disk11.rom, rgbdos.rom and optional roms/
paths.naming: Required ROMs beside the executable; optional ROMs in roms/.

linux-flatpak.reason: The pinned OVCC project documents native Linux, Windows and macOS builds but publishes no authoritative Flatpak manifest or sandbox path contract.

controller_boundary.refusal: The writer refuses unsupported keyboard-layout/flag values and never fabricates a host device identity; DiDevice must be measured from the same native SDL runtime.

notes: OVCC's source-defined Vcc.ini input fields are safe to patch in a copied baseline. Runtime activation, binary selection, SDL enumeration and effective gameplay input remain unverified.
